summary.text: Scott Collier, a Republican who has worked as a structural steel painter, home improvement specialist and media entrepreneur, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Maryland's 7th Congressional District to Kweisi Mfume.
According to Ballotpedia, he is a Dundalk High School graduate who has run for office several times since 2018 and was unopposed in the June 23, 2026 Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: Collier graduated from Dundalk High School in 1981.
His professional experience includes work as a structural steel painter and home improvement specialist, and as a media entrepreneur with DundalkTV.
Collier ran for Maryland State Senate District 6 in 2018 as an unaffiliated candidate, receiving 4.6% of the vote, and lost the 2020 Republican primary for Maryland's 2nd Congressional District.
He won the 2022 Republican primary for the 7th District seat and lost the general election to Rep. Kweisi Mfume, 82.1% to 17.7%. He ran again in 2024 and lost, receiving 17.2% to Mfume's 80.3%.
He received 15.5% of the vote to Kweisi Mfume's 84.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
